changes: Preserved and finished the pre-existing uncommitted streaming extraction; interaction.py binds compatibility methods and client.py remains thin adapters.
Paged history preserves envelopes, sorts ascending, deduplicates durable sequence/event IDs and refuses cursor cycles. Live validation established the 1..500 page limit.
stream_events now delegates to metadata-preserving stream_session; durable progress alone resets bounded exponential EOF/read-error retries; ephemeral IDs never advance durable cursors.
catch_up_truncated backfills ordered GET history before buffered SSE replay; unknown metadata and non-JSON frame data remain available in raw.
stream_control now filters locally by default. Live comparison proved server control_only=1 suppresses mcp_status liveReply, whereas unfiltered SSE delivers the correlated ephemeral response.
request_control(..., liveReply=True) attaches before writing and correlates live responses without history polling.

send_and_collect attaches before using the existing send_prompt writer; priority and message IDs pass through; reconnect never resends the prompt; result/terminal/blocking/deadline exits close owned responses.
Account watch keeps browser query fields, resumes sync IDs, remints stale/410 tokens and emits resync, including a supplied token rejected before the first successful attach.
Added heartbeat-aware deadline checks, SSE invalid ID/retry handling, isolated live smoke and opt-in CLI registration without editing group08-owned CLI/static/exports.

integration_contracts.stream_session: client.stream_session(session_id, *, from_sequence_num=0, control_only=False, reconnect=True, max_reconnects=20, liveness=45, base_delay=1, max_delay=30, on_ready=None, on_reinitialize=None, deadline=None) -> Iterator[Event]
integration_contracts.stream_control: client.stream_control(session_id, *, server_filter=False, **stream_options) -> Iterator[Event]; default local filtering preserves ephemeral verdicts
integration_contracts.send_and_collect: client.send_and_collect(session_id, text, *, print_stream=False, timeout=300, **options) -> list[Event]; options accepts reconnect/max_reconnects and existing send_prompt fields
integration_contracts.watch: client.watch(*, resume_token=None, include_trigger_sessions=True, exclude_tags="-", channels_changed=None, keepalive_tolerance_seconds=135, reconnect=True, max_reconnects=20, base_delay=1, max_delay=30) -> Iterator[WatchEvent]
integration_contracts.register_stream_commands: claude_rc.streaming.register_stream_commands(subparsers, client_factory, *, parents=()) -> None; group08 supplies existing cli._rc and credential parent; registers history, stream, watch-account and args.func
integration_contracts.dispatch_stream_command: claude_rc.streaming.dispatch_stream_command(client, args, *, emit=None) -> int; emit receives JSON-ready envelopes
integration_contracts.stream_meta: Event.raw retains event/data; no durable sequence for metadata or ephemeral frames
integration_contracts.reinitialize: on_reinitialize(update) runs on observed disconnected-to-connected transitions or explicit worker identity/reinitialize fields; integration may pass a callback using existing client.initialize. Read-only observation never silently writes a handshake.
integration_contracts.auth: All stream and backfill requests use existing _send/_request. Auth identity pin/recovery remains group01 responsibility; non-I/O policy/auth exceptions propagate rather than reconnect.
